name: close-crash-light-ranges
description: we-compare itself: the editor crashes when it is closed with View > Light Ranges on (HD) and a light on the map (a Ruins Brazier); the crash comes after the save, and we.expectCrash makes it required: the spec fails when the editor closes without crashing (the light or the toggle didn't take).
